title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v105
author: Asha Patel
description: Add v105 of the Benchmark Lab adaptive-batching reporting pipeline. This PR wires together the new adaptive-batching DAG, representative workload runners, and profiling baselines for latency and memory; it also adds telemetry hooks and a reporting job that aggregates adaptive-batching performance metrics into the central benchmark store. Motivation: we need versioned reporting for adaptive batching experiments so we can compare batch policies across hardware and model variants and detect regressions automatically. Changes include: 1) pipeline DAG with configurable sampling and windowing, 2) representative runners updated to emit batch-level and KV-cache hit metrics, 3) profiling baselines for 8/16/32k sequence lengths on common GPU shapes, 4) reporting job that generates per-run summaries and writes to the benchmark store, 5) docs and quickstart for running locally. Checklist: - [x] pipeline DAG implemented - [x] runners integrated - [x] telemetry and tags added - [x] integration tests (reporting path) - [x] docs updated - [x] perf smoke tests passed Breaking change: none. Notes: the reporting job depends on a small schema addition to benchmark-store (migration included), and the DAG supports an opt-in feature flag for gradual rollout to CI clusters.
